theory.intro: To multiply two 2-digit numbers, split **both** numbers by place value and use the area model.
steps: Split each number into tens and ones.
Multiply every part of one by every part of the other.
Add all the part-products for the total.

foundation.question_text: Use the area model to calculate $24 \times 13=(20+4)(10+3)$.
Use the area model to calculate $46 \times 27=(40+6)(20+7)$.
Use the area model to calculate $72 \times 18=(70+2)(10+8)$.

development.question_text: Use the area model to calculate $75 \times 24=(70+5)(20+4)$.

Use the area model to calculate $73 \times 22=(70+3)(20+2)$.

mastery.question_text: Use the area model to calculate $76 \times 63=(70+6)(60+3)$.
